column1: # pipelines.tsv — the stocked pipeline set and the revision each is pinned to.
# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for revisions. This file decides; nothing else does.
# Docs and READMEs do carry a revision inside runnable example commands — an
# example you cannot copy is worse than a duplicated string. Those are copies,
# not authorities: change a pin here and grep the repo for the old string.
# bin/preflight.sh reads this file and refuses a cmd.sh whose -r disagrees, so
# the run you actually launch is checked against this table, not against a doc.
# A pipeline that is not listed here is not stocked. Adding a row is a
#   revision        what -r must be. Always an exact tag, never dev/master/main.
#   schema_checked  date assets/schema_input.json was last read at this revision,
#                   or "no" if the columns are carried from knowledge rather than
#                   verified against the clone on this box.
#   note            anything that changes how the pin is chosen.
# Re-derive before the first run at any revision not used on this machine before:

column4: schema_input.json re-read this run: sample id column only, free-form otherwise; contrasts has NO json schema (validated in R) -- see samplesheets.md. -stub-run needs --features workaround with the default --gtf path, see runbook.md sec 4
3.0 is a template rewrite from 2.x - schema_input.json re-read this run: sample+fastq_1 required, fastq_2/genome optional -- matches 2.x

schema_input.json re-read this run: group+replicate+fastq_1+fastq_2+control all required (not sample); confirmed via main.nf/prepare_genome.nf that compact --genome form never touches bwa/star/chromap (unlike chipseq) and that the target-genome index param is --bowtie2, not --bowtie2_index
compact --genome form broken for this pipeline/nf-validation combo -- see config/genomes.config section 3a; use explicit --fasta/--gtf

16S/ITS amplicon, DADA2+QIIME2; samplesheet takes sampleID+forwardReads/reverseReads OR sample+fastq_1/fastq_2 -- mutually exclusive per-sheet (schema oneOf/not:anyOf rejects mixing), see samplesheets.md; -stub-run fails at CUTADAPT_BASIC (upstream module bug, stub: block never sets `outformat` -- waived, 4th documented departure, see runbook.md sec 4); taxonomy DBs self-fetched via PREPTAX, cache with --ref_taxonomy_storage

shotgun metagenome assembly+binning+QC; samplesheet is sample+group required, short_reads_1(+2, +platform) and/or long_reads(+platform), uniqueEntries=[sample,run] is a COMPOSITE key (empirically confirmed via -preview: same sample/different run passes, same sample+run or same sample with no run column both fail) -- see samplesheets.md; -stub-run fails at UNTAR (CATPACK_DB_UNTAR/BUSCO_UNTAR) because mag's own untar.diff patch sets `output_dir` in script: but never in stub: -- waived, 5th documented departure, see runbook.md sec 4; ONLY exercised when a .tar.gz db is supplied (cat_db/busco_db/checkm without local db/genomad_db), not on a default real run; --skip_gtdbtk true required unless the user approves the default GTDB-Tk DB's 60.8 GB download (measured via curl -sI)

shotgun metagenome taxonomic profiling (no assembly, lighter than mag); samplesheet is sample+run_accession+instrument_platform required (schema does NOT require fastq_1/fastq_2/fasta -- a row with none of them validates cleanly, see samplesheets.md), uniqueEntries=[sample,run_accession] is a COMPOSITE key (same shape as mag's [sample,run], empirically confirmed via -preview), but fastq_1/fastq_2/fasta are EACH ALSO their own separate per-field uniqueEntries -- reusing one FASTQ path across two sheet rows is a hard schema failure here (unlike mag); separate --databases CSV (tool+db_name+db_path required) selects which of 14 profilers run, none stocked by default -- this procurement stocks ONLY kraken2 against a small 8 GB-capped standard DB (see refs.manifest.tsv db/kraken2/), not the full tool roster, per "lightest combination first"; -stub-run PASSES cleanly end to end (completed=176 failed=0) with all 14 profilers on the CI test fixtures -- no waiver needed, unlike ampliseq/mag

Oxford Nanopore long-read demux+QC+alignment (DNA/cDNA/directRNA) -- FIRST long-read-only pipeline stocked here (mag/taxprofiler accept long reads as one input type among several; nanoseq is ONT-only, see pipeline-selection.md sec 4.14); assets/schema_input.json (sample/fastq_1/fastq_2) is NEVER REFERENCED by any .nf file at this pin (grepped workflows/subworkflows/modules for schema_input/validateParameters/nf-schema/nf-validation -- nothing) -- vestigial nf-core-template leftover; the samplesheet actually enforced is the pipeline's OWN bin/check_samplesheet.py (via SAMPLESHEET_CHECK module) against header group,replicate,barcode,input_file,fasta,gtf, confirmed by reading subworkflows/local/input_check.nf; MIN_COLS=3 populated fields/row, group no-spaces, replicate/barcode bare integers, replicate ids 1..N contiguous per group, all input_file entries must share ONE extension family (.fastq.gz/.fq.gz/.bam) across the whole sheet, fasta accepts plain .fa/.fasta (gzip optional, unlike taxprofiler's fasta column) -- see samplesheets.md; stocked scope: --protocol DNA, already-basecalled FASTQ given directly as input_file with --skip_demultiplexing true (lightest entry point -- avoids qcat/--input_path/--barcode_kit and any GPU-basecalling assumption), --skip_quantification/--skip_differential_analysis/--skip_fusion_analysis/--skip_modification_analysis true (RNA-only subworkflows, N/A for DNA protocol), --call_variants left off (medaka/DeepVariant not exercised this procurement), minimap2 aligner (default); -stub-run on the CI test profile (-profile test,docker, DNA+qcat demux): completed=24 failed=4 -- WAIVED, 6th documented departure (same class as ampliseq's CUTADAPT_BASIC/mag's UNTAR): modules/nf-core/samtools/{idxstats,flagstat}/main.nf have NO stub: block while samtools/sort/main.nf's stub produces a header-less empty .bam, so idxstats/flagstat run for REAL against it and correctly refuse to read it -- confirmed by reading all four modules' main.nf directly, not a nanoseq or config defect

Alternative splicing analysis from RNA-seq -- FIRST splicing-specific pipeline stocked here (nf-core/rnaseq, already stocked, quantifies gene/transcript expression but computes no PSI/splicing-event/differential-splicing statistics; see pipeline-selection.md sec 4.15 for the rnaseq contrast); assets/schema_input.json (sample/fastq_1/fastq_2/strandedness/condition) is NEVER REFERENCED by any .nf file at this pin for the fastq source (same class of finding as nanoseq -- grepped workflows/subworkflows/modules, nothing wired to it) -- the samplesheet actually enforced is the pipeline's own bin/check_samplesheet_fastq.py via the local SAMPLESHEET_CHECK module, confirmed by reading it directly: required header set {sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,strandedness,condition} (fastq_2 header required even for SE, value may be empty), strandedness enum is {unstranded,forward,reverse} ONLY -- 'auto' is REJECTED (unlike rnaseq), condition is a syntactically-validated free-form group label, uniqueness key is the (sample,fastq_1) PAIR not sample alone (repeat sample name across different fastq_1 = supported multi-run merge, auto-suffixed _T1/_T2), and check_condition_replicates() (meant to enforce >=2 rows per condition) is DEAD CODE -- it is called on an already-exhausted csv.DictReader iterator so it never fires for any input, confirmed empirically via -stub-run (SAMPLESHEET_CHECK has no stub: block, so it runs for real): a singleton-condition sheet passed cleanly with no error; see samplesheets.md. SEPARATE, ALSO IMPORTANT: nextflow_schema.json's stated per-flag defaults (surfaced by --help) do NOT match nextflow.config's actual params{} block at this pin -- --help shows aligner=star, rmats/dexseq_exon/edger_exon/dexseq_dtu/sashimi_plot all default false, but nextflow.config actually sets aligner='star_salmon' and ALL FIVE of those true; confirmed by reading nextflow.config directly and by -preview's params-differ-from-default summary. Stocked scope, chosen to avoid the unscoped kitchen-sink default: --skip_alignment true (skips STAR entirely; SUPPA runs off plain Salmon pseudo-alignment, not the STAR+Salmon combined path -- structurally also gates off rmats/dexseq_exon/edger_exon/dexseq_dtu/sashimi_plot since all five are nested inside `if (!params.skip_alignment ...)` in workflows/rnasplice.nf, confirmed by reading it) plus --rmats/--dexseq_exon/--edger_exon/--dexseq_dtu/--sashimi_plot all false explicitly (redundant with skip_alignment's structural gate, kept explicit so the config is self-documenting rather than relying on that side effect), --pseudo_aligner salmon + --suppa true kept at default (SUPPA2: event/isoform generation, per-event/per-isoform PSI, differential splicing dPSI+significance -- the splicing-detection core this procurement exercises), --clusterevents_local_event/--clusterevents_isoform both false (SUPPA's DBSCAN clustering of significant events, default true -- disabled after a REAL reproducible failure on the CI test fixture: when 0 events survive the significance threshold, `suppa.py clusterEvents` prints "Impossible to calculate silhouette score. Only 1 cluster group identified." and never writes the expected `*.clustvec` output, failing the whole run -- completed=42 failed=4 with clustering on vs completed=34 failed=0 with it off, same flag set otherwise; a genuine small-sample-size edge case in the tool, not a stub artifact, not fixed upstream, just out of scope since it's a display layer on top of the PSI/dPSI numbers this procurement actually ships). rMATS/DEXSeq DEU/edgeR DEU/DEXSeq DTU/Miso sashimi all out of scope: redundant or STAR-dependent detection/visualization methods beyond SUPPA2's own core+DTU-equivalent coverage, same "lightest combination first" pattern as taxprofiler's kraken2-only and raredisease's --skip_subworkflows stocking. -stub-run has ONE documented departure (7th of this class in this repo, same shape as ampliseq's CUTADAPT_BASIC/mag's UNTAR/nanoseq's idxstats-flagstat): modules/nf-core/gunzip/main.nf's stub: block does `touch $gunzip` (an EMPTY placeholder file) for WHICHEVER of --fasta/--gtf is gzipped, and the downstream local modules/local/gtf_gene_filter.nf + modules/nf-core/rsem/preparereference/main.nf have NO stub: block at all, so they run FOR REAL against that empty stub input -- reproduced BOTH ways: on the nf-core CI fixture (gzipped fasta, plain gtf) filter_gtf_for_genes_in_genome.py extracts 0 chromosome names from the empty stub fasta and writes an empty GTF, then rsem-prepare-reference fails with "The reference contains no transcripts!"; on this procurement's own real-sample sheet (plain R64-1-1 fasta, gzipped gtf) the fasta is real (16 real chromosome names extracted) but the gtf comes from GUNZIP_GTF's empty stub, so filter_gtf_for_genes_in_genome.py instead extracts 0/0 lines from an empty GTF and SUPPA's GENERATE_EVENTS then fails with "No exons found" -- same root cause, different file triggers it depending on which input the samplesheet happens to gzip; confirmed by reading both modules and inspecting the stub work-dirs' actual empty files directly; WAIVED, this is upstream stub-coverage incompleteness in genome preparation, not a real pipeline defect -- the REAL (non-stub) `-profile test,docker` run with the identical flag set completes cleanly (completed=34 failed=0, see estimates.md). SEPARATE REAL-RUN FINDING (not a stub artifact, hit on the real 8-sample S. cerevisiae run, 2026-08-14): with `suppa_per_local_event` left at its true default, `SUPPA_SALMON:GENERATE_EVENTS_IOE` hung for 53 real minutes at 99% CPU and never returned -- modules/local/suppa_generateevents.nf's per-event-type .ioe concatenation (`awk 'FNR==1 && NR!=1 { while (/^seqname/) getline; } 1 {print}' *.ioe`) spins forever once any of the six event-type files is header-only (zero local-splicing events of that type -- yeast's local/exon-level AS rate against this annotation is essentially nil), because getline at EOF returns 0 without changing $0 so the while condition never goes false; reproduced the identical hang standalone in 5s on two synthetic header-only .ioe files (confirming it is a real, deterministic pipeline bug, not this run's data or the container). Routed around with --suppa_per_local_event false (structurally skips GENERATE_EVENTS_IOE, confirmed via subworkflows/local/suppa.nf's `if (suppa_per_local_event)` gate) added mid-run, then -resume (completed=2 failed=0 cached=38, all prior per-isoform SUPPA work reused). STOCKED SCOPE THEREFORE NARROWED to per-isoform-only SUPPA2 (--suppa_per_local_event false) as the safe default for any low-alternative-splicing-rate organism/annotation, not just this procurement's yeast dataset -- see estimates.md and pipeline-selection.md sec 4.15 for the full real-sample numbers (8 samples, mapping rate 92.5-95.8%, WT_ibuoh-vs-WT_ctrl per-isoform dPSI table 6685 rows).

WGS/WES rare-disease variant CALLING+SCORING (not just calling) -- overlaps sarek only in alignment/basic SNV/SV calling; adds HPO/pedigree-ranking (GENMOD), CADD/VEP annotation, SVDB frequency annotation, ExpansionHunter repeats, SMNCopyNumberCaller, none of which sarek has -- see pipeline-selection.md sec 4.13; samplesheet required[]=sample+sex+phenotype+case_id (schema_input.json re-read this run), sex enum 0/1/2/other, phenotype enum 0/1/2 (PED convention, not free text); accepts fastq_1(+lane)/spring_1/bam(+bai) as alternate read sources, no single one required at schema level unless `lane` column present; schema's "uniqueEntries":["case_id"] is placed INSIDE items (not at the array's own top level) so nf-schema's UniqueEntriesEvaluator never sees an array node and the keyword is a NO-OP as authored -- empirically confirmed via -preview: the pipeline's own multi-row same-case_id test fixture AND a fully duplicated row both validate cleanly; repeated case_id across a family's rows is the pipeline's normal intended shape, not a defect; --genome is a closed enum (GRCh37/GRCh38 only, no `null`, unlike sarek) and --intervals_wgs/--intervals_y are schema-required with NO default (built this run via `gatk ScatterIntervalsByNs -OT ACGT` then filtered to chr1-22/X/Y/M, stored at GRCh38gatk/intervals/); CADD resources/VEP cache/gnomad_af/vcfanno bundle/GENMOD rank configs/ExpansionHunter catalog/GATK-CNV cohort model all MISSING from $BIOINFO_REFS and NOT fetched this run -- stocked with --skip_subworkflows snv_annotation,sv_annotation,mt_annotation,repeat_calling,repeat_annotation,me_calling,me_annotation,generate_clinical_set --skip_tools gens,germlinecnvcaller (alignment+QC+DeepVariant SNV+Manta/Tiddit/CNVnator SV+MT subworkflow only), same "lightest combination first" pattern as taxprofiler's kraken2-only stocking; -stub-run PASSES cleanly at this flag set (completed=42 failed=0) -- no waiver needed; full annotation/scoring stack's stub behaviour NOT exercised, scope explicitly narrower than a full nf-core CI run
